item.title: All node types: Node's nine methods, six built-in nodes, and NodeConfig's tri-state pointers
item.description: The node layer of the ADK Go v2.4.0 graph engine: when each of the nine workflow.Node methods is called, BaseNode and custom nodes, the four constructors of the FunctionNode family (including FromState's parameter binding and the node_input escape hatch), EmittingFunctionFn, the constructors and semantics of AgentNode/ToolNode/JoinNode/WorkflowNode/ParallelWorker, and why the seven NodeConfig fields (ParallelWorker/RerunOnResume/WaitForOutput/RetryConfig/Timeout/EmitsOwnSpan) use pointers.
